title: Electric Heart in Crystal Ball
description: A glowing purple heart with a melting neon green smile and eyes floats inside a transparent crystal ball. Blue electrical arcs emanate from a human finger touching the sphere, which rests on a dark base with dripping green slime and a small smiley face.
prompt: A surreal glowing heart with a dripping neon green smile and cartoon eyes floats inside a large transparent crystal ball. The heart is purple and melting with green slime dripping down. Blue lightning arcs connect from a human finger on the right touching the glass. The orb sits on a dark base with green slime and a small smiley face oozing out. Dark background with vibrant neon lighting.
